description: ABI Coverage Grid manifest — the single source of truth for thin-corner runtime coverage cells. See src/docs/Design/abi-coverage-grid.md. Phase 0 seeds a representative subset of EXISTING passing closure/tuple/inout tests to prove the report/gate plumbing end-to-end; Phase 1 authors the genuinely-unreached Latent-tied cells the audit exposes. Cells map to tests by (class, method) name over the existing test-results JSONL + TestClasses.g.txt inventory — no test-infra change (the [AbiCell] attribute is deferred to v2). 'runtimes' defaults to [sim, device]; the Phase 0 seed cells are sim-only by scope (device leg lands with Phase 1) and say so in 'runtimeNote'.
